competencies.name: JavaScript
competencies.description: Programming language of the web

competencies.name: TypeScript
competencies.description: Typed superset of JavaScript for safer code

prerequisites.notes: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript, so JavaScript fundamentals are essential

competencies.name: Python
competencies.description: High-level programming language

competencies.name: Java
competencies.description: Object-oriented programming language used for enterprise applications, Android development, and backend systems

alternatives.notes: C# and Java share similar syntax and object-oriented paradigms, both used for enterprise development
Kotlin is a modern alternative to Java, especially for Android development, and runs on the JVM

competencies.name: C
competencies.description: Low-level systems programming language known for performance and hardware control

competencies.name: C++
competencies.description: High-performance programming language for systems, games, and applications requiring speed

prerequisites.notes: Understanding C helps with C++ fundamentals, but not strictly required

alternatives.notes: Rust offers similar performance to C++ with memory safety guarantees

competencies.name: C#
competencies.description: Modern object-oriented language for .NET development, games (Unity), and enterprise applications

alternatives.notes: Java and C# share similar syntax and object-oriented paradigms

competencies.name: Go
competencies.description: Simple and efficient language for building scalable backend services and cloud infrastructure

alternatives.notes: Both are modern systems languages with strong concurrency support

competencies.name: Rust
competencies.description: Memory-safe systems programming language for performance-critical applications

alternatives.notes: Both are systems languages, but Rust provides memory safety without garbage collection
Both are modern systems languages with strong concurrency, but different philosophies

competencies.name: Swift
competencies.description: Modern programming language for iOS, macOS, and Apple platform development

alternatives.notes: Swift is the modern replacement for Objective-C in Apple ecosystem

competencies.name: Kotlin
competencies.description: Modern JVM language for Android development and server-side applications

prerequisites.notes: Understanding Java helps with Kotlin, but not required as Kotlin can be learned independently

alternatives.notes: Kotlin is designed as a better Java, runs on JVM, and is interoperable with Java

competencies.name: Objective-C
competencies.description: Object-oriented language used for Apple platform development before Swift

prerequisites.notes: Objective-C is built on top of C

competencies.name: Ruby
competencies.description: Dynamic programming language known for elegant syntax and Rails web framework

alternatives.notes: Both are dynamic, high-level languages with clean syntax and strong web frameworks

competencies.name: PHP
competencies.description: Server-side scripting language widely used for web development

alternatives.notes: Both are popular for backend web development
Both are commonly used for server-side web development

competencies.name: Bash
competencies.description: Unix shell and command language for automation and system administration

competencies.name: PowerShell
competencies.description: Task automation and configuration management framework from Microsoft

alternatives.notes: Both are shell scripting languages, PowerShell for Windows/cross-platform, Bash for Unix/Linux

competencies.name: Lua
competencies.description: Lightweight scripting language used in game development and embedded systems

competencies.name: Perl
competencies.description: Text processing and system administration language

competencies.description: Statistical programming language for data analysis and visualization
